jobs.occupation: International Clinician Scientist (f/d/m) for iPRACTIS (Wissenschaftliche/r Mitarbeiter/in)
jobs.description: Die Medizinische Hochschule Hannover (MHH), mit rund 10.000 Beschäftigten größter Landesbetrieb des Landes Niedersachsen, ist eine universitäre Einrichtung für Forschung und Lehre in der Human- und Zahnmedizin und ein Universitätsklinikum der Supramaximalversorgung. Forschung, Lehre, Krankenversorgung und Administration arbeiten im Integrationsmodell auf dem MHH-Campus Hand in Hand.About usHannover Medical School (MHH) is offering positions in the international clinician scientist program (iPRACTIS), a unique opportunity for internationally mobile researchers with a completed medical degree outside of Germany. Over three years, you will gain experience in translational research while working towards medical degree recognition in Germany.iPRACTIS supports internationally trained researchers aiming to build careers in academic medicine. Over three years, participants will deepen their research experience on a translational research project while working towards integration into the German academic and healthcare system.We offerThe international clinician scientist program iPRACTIS offers:- 36 months of structured clinical and scientific training based on an individually tailored career plan- Individualized support in navigating the process of medical degree recognition in Germany and developing German language proficiency- Funding for materials, travel, and publication- Individualized support from a personalized mentoring team- A curriculum to acquire key competencies [including data management and analysis, GCP clinical investigator certification (GCP-Prüfarztkurs), project management]- Regular evaluations and feedback meetings- A full onboarding program and integration into a strong Clinician Scientist NetworkClinical expectations: Participants will achieve recognition of their medical qualifications along with sufficient German language skills for clinical practice, allowing future specialist training and medical practice in Germany.Research expectations: Participants will develop as a R2 researcher (according to the European Framework for Research Careers), including submitting their first third-party funding application. Participants who complete this process will be ready to pursue an independent research career (R3) in roles such as assistant professor, principal investigator, or junior group leader.Eligibility requirementsTo apply, candidates must:- Hold a completed medical degree (from outside Germany)- Have initial research experience (completed R1 to early R2 based on European Framework for Research Careers)- Have not yet completed specialist clinical training (residency or German 'Facharzt' / 'Weiterbildung' equivalent)- Be committed to pursuing a career combining clinical practice and researchIn order to consider your application, we require that you submit the completed "iPRACTIS Application Template" (download) as well as a cover letter and detailed resume (in table format), a declaration of consent and copies of certificates (medical examination certificates, doctoral degree certificates, high school diplomas, and other relevant certificates and documents. If the documents are not in German or English, a certified translation is requested). Please submit your application as a single PDF file directly to practis@mh-hannover.de. More information can be found at iPRACTIS.External applications for iPRACTIS positions will be reviewed on a rolling basis. The deadline for internal applications is 05.01.2027.For questions, please reach out to Dr. Thorsten Saenger: practis@mh-hannover.de.Ergänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Grundkenntnisse: Forschung, Lehrtätigkeit (Hochschule)

jobs.occupation: PMT Leader Test Means (d/f/m) (Elektroniker/in - Informations- und Systemtechnik)
jobs.description: About usAirbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.Job descriptionIn order to support the Test Means Design Team in Bremen, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for aPMT Leader Test Means (d/f/m)The Test Means Design Team in Bremen is one of four transnational Design Offices focused on Test Means Design and Integration for Flight Test (FTI) and Lab Test Means (LTM). FTI prepares development aircraft to perform tests essential for the development, improvement, and certification of our aircraft. A key challenge for LTM is aligning industrial bench standards with the aircraft environment of the examinees.The Bremen team is responsible for the customized engineering of Functional Electric (FE) and Test System Installation (ESI/MSI). Working across several programs and MSNs, team members are required to have strong proficiency in the relevant toolsets.In this role, your primary responsibility will be to provide operational support to the Design Office regarding Process, Methods, and Tools (PMT), specifically for Functional Electrical design activities. Additionally, you will serve as the PMT focal point for the specification, testing, and deployment of new solutions within a transnational framework.Your locationBremen is a charming city full of history in the northwest of Germany. In addition to being one of the country’s greenest cities, it offers wonderful sights, a rich culture, urban flair and culinary delights. It’s also a great place for seaside lovers, being located just an hour’s drive from the North Sea coast.Our Benefits for You- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.Your tasks and responsibilities- Starting with operational support to the FE team in their day-to-day work, specifically regarding Process, Methods, and Tooling issues- Acting as the focal point for all FE design toolsets, across all programs and National Companies (NatCos)- Participating in the deployment of any new Airbus tools within the various teams (Design, Business, etc.)- Serving as a Business Representative within the context of digital transformation projects- Acting as a key reference point for the usage of FE design tools- Gathering requirements to support the creation of new tools- Regular travels between Airbus Sites are expectedDesired skills and qualifications- You have a degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Aeronautics or equivalent- You already have ideally practical experience in Design or Functional Electric and corresponding PLM Toolsets, like: CAPITAL, CORE ELEC, CIRCE, SEE XP, ESDCR, CCD, TAKSY, ELSY- Knowledge of Electrical Functional Design would be a valuable asset for your application.- You are autonomous, inquisitive, and proactive- You are open-minded and possess strong analytical and synthesis skills, with the ability to step back from day-to-day activities to propose new ideas- Working at Airbus involves operating in an international environment; therefore, you must be able to communicate fluently in English. (French is a plus)- You have already solid experience in project management and are capable of switching between different topics while maintaining a strong team spirit- Good knowledge of tool development and LBIP+ Methodology is an assetNot a 100% match?
